## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2022-02-11: Executed TRA dated as of de-SPAC close with Thayer Ventures Acquisition Corp., 85% of cash tax savings to Continuing Inspirato Members
- 2022-02-14: 8-K reports close and attaches the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.4

#### August 2024 reorganization and TRA termination

- 2024-08-09: TRA terminated by the company and the signatory parties for a $0.3M ($250K) full-and-final cash settlement; standalone termination instrument not filed as exhibit
- 2024-11-12: Q3 2024 10-Q discloses the termination as part of the broader 2024 Reorganization Plan (lease termination, reduction in force, $88M One Planet investment, CEO change, Board reconstitution)

## Explanation

Inspirato executed its Tax Receivable Agreement at the February 2022 close of the de-SPAC business combination with Thayer Ventures, committing to pay 85% of the cash tax savings on Section 754 basis step-ups (on exchanges of Inspirato LLC Common Units or Blocker stock for Class A common stock) plus imputed interest to the Continuing Inspirato Members. The company maintained a full valuation allowance against the underlying deferred tax assets throughout the in-force period, so no TRA liability ever accrued on the balance sheet, making the TRA economically zero-value to the beneficiaries. As part of the August 2024 Reorganization Plan (lease termination, reduction in force, $88M One Planet investment, CEO change), the company and signatory parties terminated the TRA for a $0.3M full-and-final cash settlement on August 9, 2024; the standalone termination agreement was not filed as an SEC exhibit but is documented in the Q3 2024 10-Q and FY2024 10-K. The subsequent December 2025 Exclusive Investments going-private merger postdates the termination and does not affect the TRA. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
